title: Quickstart completion in an illustrative trial
method: Fictional trial of five unfamiliar readers using the same quickstart and a 30-minute cutoff. Completion is 3/5 = 60%. Incomplete attempts remain in the denominator; this small sample is diagnostic, not a population estimate.
alt: Quickstart completion in an illustrative trial. Completed within 30 minutes: 3 readers; Still blocked at cutoff: 2 readers. Illustrative inputs.
